Who we are

We do things a little differently.

SCS Automotive is a Boksburg workshop run by Saish & Christabel, built for people who actually care about their cars. We don't guess and we don't fire the parts cannon. Every car goes through a proper diagnostic procedure, gets a full health check, and comes back with a clear explanation of what we found and what we did.

From daily-driven 1 Series to big-turbo builds and M cars, the same standard applies under the hex lights.

Built right, and built to last.— The SCS standard
What we do

Services

Specialist BMW care, from first diagnosis through to custom tuning. If it's a BMW, it's welcome here.

01

Diagnostics

Sporadic errors, loss of power, warning lights. We run a full diagnostic procedure to find the real fault, not just clear the code.

  • Fault finding
  • Health inspections
  • Pre-purchase checks
02

Maintenance

Annual services and fluid work done to spec with quality products, followed by a comprehensive vehicle overview.

  • Liqui Moly services
  • DCT service + adaptation
  • Battery & electrical
03

Cooling systems

N55 and B58 cooling systems can be temperamental. We repair them properly, including jobs other shops started.

  • Water pumps
  • Coolant leaks
  • Oil filter housings
04

Performance

Hardware and software that are reliable as well as fast. Performance starts with reliability.

  • Downpipes
  • Hybrid turbos
  • ECU unlock & tunes
  • Ethanol
  • XHP TCU flash
05

Suspension & chassis

Suspension refreshes, subframe work and setup, so the car feels as good as it looks.

  • Suspension
  • Bushings
  • Subframes
06

Engine health

PCV failures, boost leaks and inlet upgrades. We keep the engine breathing clean and boosting as it should.

  • PCV systems
  • Boost leak tests
  • Hi-flow inlets
